text:
rachel: Opening a tiny docs PR to unify streaming examples across Py/TS/Go for SDK >=1.12. Goal: 3 micro-snippets per language (iterator, callback shim, retry note). Keep each snippet <=6 lines.

tom: Good plan. For TS show `for await (const part of client.stream(...))` and then a one-liner adapter `const shim = (cb) => (async ()=>{ for await (p of it) cb(p.text) })()` — emphasise it returns a cancel handle.

priya: For Python: `async for chunk in client.stream(...):` then `def attach(on_message): asyncio.create_task(_pump(on_message))` as the shim. Add comment: "do not put retry/backoff inside _pump; handle retries upstream".

rachel: Go snippet: `for { resp, err := stream.Recv(); if err!=nil { break } handler(resp.Text) }` and provide `WrapStream(ctx, handler)` that spawns a goroutine; mention use of `context` for cancel.

doc-bot: Suggested PR description checklist: SDK version note, manual sanity commands (python -c "print('ok')" / node -e "console.log('ok')"), link to migration guide section.

tom: Also ping platform about renaming `on_data`->`on_message` in the docs; I updated occurrences in the draft.

priya: Small migration caveat to add: "If you use pagination tokens in streaming payloads, the shim must surface tokens to caller so the continuation isn't lost."

rachel: Agreed. I'll add a bullet under each shim: "preserve pagination tokens / continuation metadata."

ci-bot: Branch created: docs/streaming-micro-shims. Running docs linter and snippet-check.

rachel: Pushed PR #12 with files under `docs/snippets/streaming/shims/`. WIP. Link: https://git.example/redwood/docs/pull/12

tom: Quick nit posted: shorten the TS adapter to one real-world line and remove `any` types.

priya: Added a one-line code comment about `retry_after` header handling for hosted API clients — show `if resp.rate_limit.retry_after: sleep(retry_after)` in pseudocode.

doc-bot: Lint warnings: one long line in TS snippet.

rachel: Fixed formatting, replaced long line with tiny helper. Ready for review.

ci-bot: All checks green. Merged PR #12 into main.

priya: Added entry to Release Notes: "streaming API: iterator pattern preferred; callback shims available (see snippets)."

rachel: Will post a short announcement in #announcements tomorrow and drop links in the SDK migration checklist. Closing thread. :shipit:
